goal: A live Codex read-only candidate check crashed in all six projects with an unhandled FileNotFoundError from tempfile.mkdtemp in role_prompts: turn an unavailable temporary scratch directory on hunsu's check, compose, lock and judge paths into a clear nonzero diagnostic — no traceback, no machine paths, no silently omitted roles or stale judgments, no false pass — keep successful behavior, and document that check reads project data but may need temporary scratch files
brief: Add regression tests to the existing test_hunsu.py (plain test_ functions run by its __main__; keep every existing test unchanged) for an unavailable temporary directory on hunsu's check, compose, lock, judge and SessionStart-hook paths, per the contract. Build the fixture first, then make tempfile fail only around the command under test (gettempdir raising FileNotFoundError with machine-like paths in its message; mkdtemp raising PermissionError); observe exit code, output/stderr (one subprocess run, finding no Traceback) and project file bytes. They must fail against the current hunsu.py because of the real defect (the unhandled exception, traceback, missing diagnostic) — never because they import a name the fix has not added. A Q-success-unchanged test (roles render the same text once a temporary directory is available again) may pass before the build. Temporary trees and the file's fake hosts only — never a real plugin cache, ~/.claude, ~/.codex or another project. Run with AGENT_WORKER unset (three existing hook tests fail under a worker's AGENT_WORKER=1)
